tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 2nd house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through money, resources, values, and self-worth.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 2nd house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through money, resources, values, and self-worth. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered in this part of life. You refuse to be controlled through money or made to feel undeserving; raw drive around resources and worth. A conflicted relationship with money: rejecting it as a symbol of control while secretly wanting it intensely, plus a fear of loss. Can unconsciously create scarcity until the conflict is faced.
business: The disowned self activates through money, resources, values, and self-worth. Reclaims financial autonomy and the right to your own value.
shadow: Money as a battleground, or shame and self-denial around having.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 2nd house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with money, resources, values, and self-worth directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
